pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark brown patches exhibit multi-pointed, irregular polygonal geometries. Edges show moderate pixel-level angularity with sharp transitions between the pigmented regions and the surrounding light corridors.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The network of light-colored pelage forms a topological grid with numerous Y-shaped junction nodes. The pixel thickness of these corridors remains largely consistent across the visible flank and neck surfaces.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible as a short, stiff, and continuous hair line along the dorsal edge of the neck, exhibiting a fine-grained, low-amplitude jagged profile against the background.
